text: Large multi-feature requests are split into a foundation issue plus one issue per feature, each linked to the foundation and the original request.
The `revisions-required` outcome label may not exist in a fresh repo; create it with `gh label create` (color FBCA04) before applying it.

When a review requires manual browser/device testing the agent cannot do, fix the code issues, post a blocking PR comment, apply `human-decision-required` (not `ready-for-review`) and ask a human to record the results.
child-page activities plug in by overriding `mount` of their entry in window.ACTIVITIES from a new js/<name>.js loaded before app.js in index.html; mount returns a cleanup function.

child-page star/constellation-style activities: build a square sky sized min(94vw, 100dvh - reserved) with percent-positioned <button> nodes (56px) and an SVG overlay, so shapes stay fully visible after orientation change.

child-page: day/night-style activities drive transitions with a single rAF loop (capped dt, restarted on visibilitychange) setting a --p CSS variable, so transitions still work under the global prefers-reduced-motion rule that disables CSS animations/transitions.

child-page: for 'smooth redirect' motion (target changes mid-flight) keep position+velocity state and integrate a damped spring toward the target (optionally rotate the pull vector for a curved path) instead of re-fitting a Bezier; drive wings/sway from the same rAF loop so prefers-reduced-motion doesn't disable them.
